enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe steadily. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Remain asleep. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, showering and personal hygiene
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up in bed. Stretch arms. Turn off alarm on phone. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Take off pajamas. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Shampoo hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Walk to sink. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wipe mouth. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cupboard. Take out bowl and pan. Close cupboard. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Pour oil into pan. Pour eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Stir eggs. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Open refrigerator. Take out bread. Close refrigerator. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Wait for toast. Toast pops up. Pick up toast. Place on plate. Open refrigerator. Take out butter. Close refrigerator. Spread butter on toast. Pick up plate. Walk to table. Sit down. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Stand up. Pick up plate and glass. Walk to sink. Place dishes in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing work bag for the shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Close wardrobe. Lay clothes on bed. Take off towel. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Open drawer. Take out underwear. Close drawer. Put on underwear. Walk to desk. Pick up work bag. Open work bag. Check contents. Place stethoscope in bag. Place notebook in bag. Place pen in bag. Zip work bag. Pick up phone. Put phone in pocket. Pick up keys. Put keys in pocket. Walk to door.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Read messages. Put phone away. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk to hospital entrance. Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Store personal items in locker. Walk to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, attending patients and clinical duties
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at ward. Wash hands. Pick up patient chart. Review notes. Enter patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Listen to heart. Listen to lungs. Adjust IV drip. Administer medication. Record notes. Wash hands. Move to next patient. Repeat. Attend meeting. Update records. Take break. Eat lunch. Return to ward. Continue patient care. End shift. Handover to next shift.

Walk out of hospital. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit. Look out window. Check phone. Put phone away. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk to home. Unlock door. Enter home. Close door. Lock door.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing hands and freshening up after work
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Dry hands. Splash water on face. Pat face dry. Brush hair. Apply deodorant. Change into comfortable clothes. Walk out of bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Open cupboard. Take out pan. Close cupboard. Turn on stove. Pour oil into pan. Chop vegetables. Add vegetables to pan. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Add spices. Cook. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Walk to table. Sit down. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Place plate in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up kitchen and washing dishes
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on tap. Pick up sponge. Apply dish soap. Wash plate. Rinse plate. Place in dish rack. Wash glass. Rinse glass. Place in dish rack. Wash utensils. Rinse utensils. Place in dish rack. Turn off tap. Wipe counter with cloth. Throw away trash. Sweep floor. Put away dishes. Turn off kitchen light. Walk out of kitchen.

Enter living room. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Sit on couch. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put phone down. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Eat snack. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Nighttime hygiene routine and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wipe mouth. Wash face. Dry face. Apply moisturizer. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wash body. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body. Put on pajamas. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and winding down for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on bedside lamp. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read more. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Turn off lamp. Pull back blanket. Lie down. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Remain still.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Remain asleep. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Shift position. Continue sleeping. Stretch legs. Sigh. Remain asleep.
